# rust-target

Cargo's build output. It is rebuilt by the next cargo build.

**Name:** Rust target · **Category:** Project artifacts · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux, Windows

Upstream docs: <https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/build-cache.html>

## In projects

| Folder | Only when | Safety | Why | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | next to `Cargo.toml` | Safe; Review if the project was used recently | Your build tools recreate this automatically (`REGENERABLE`) | `quarantine` |

To get it back: `cargo build`.
